notes.title: Day one patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone just a quick launch day patch.

 Fixed unfinished geometry.
 Fixed a visual bug towards the end of the game.
 Achievement "Brave but Blind" was incorrectly being awarded.
 Added more ammo to be found.

Known bugs

 Un-crouching can sometimes cause you to get stuck. Re-crouching will fix this. 
 Sometimes there is a delay when interacting with doors and objects.

Gameplay Changes

 Replaced instant death with a health based system.
Grenades and explosives have a radius only a point blank shot will one shot the player.
Soldiers now deal less damage over longer range giving a brief moment to return fire or run.
Added a death counter, players were thinking the game restarted after their first death.


Thanks all and have fun playing!

Daniel
